values.note: RV sites (all electric) $25 a night; the $20 first-come sites are tent sites for vehicles to 22 ft; cabins $40.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/cheoah-point-recreation-area ('$20 per night first come first served; $25 per night for RV sites; $40 per night for cabins') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234583/rates (2026 and 2027: STANDARD ELECTRIC 25, STANDARD NONELECTRIC 20) + RIDB catalog (the 17 non-electric sites: equipment TENT, Max Vehicle Length 22), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234583 (notice: 'Direct sewer and water hook-ups are not available at the six reservable RV sites. These sites do offer 15/30/50 amp electric hookups.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Six reservable RV sites (18-23), all electric, back-in, to 40 ft; 17 first-come non-electric sites are tent sites (vehicle to 22 ft). Steep terrain; many sites overlook the lake.

sites.source: RIDB catalog for 234583 (sites 18-23 STANDARD ELECTRIC, RV/MOTORHOME, Back-In, Max Vehicle Length 40; sites 01-17 STANDARD NONELECTRIC, TENT, 22, not reservable) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234583 ('Six RV sites provide 15/30/50 amp electrical hookups', 'The campground covers steep terrain and many of the campsites overlook the lake'), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234583 ('Flush toilets, hot showers and drinking water are provided', 'Water hydrants are available throughout the campground', 'There is not a dump station at the campground'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The boat launch is open year-round.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/northcarolina/recreation/cheoah-point-recreation-area ('Campground & Beach: Open April 15 - October 31', 'Boat Launch: Open year round'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Run by the Forest Service's Cheoah Ranger District (not a concession). The six RV sites are reservable; the 17 tent sites are first-come. Check-in after 2 p.m., check-out by 2 p.m.; 2 vehicles and 8 people per site; generators 3 hours total between 10 a.m. and 10 p.m.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234583 ('The maximum length of stay is 14 days', 'Check-in time is after 2 PM', 'Generators may only be used for a total of no more than 3 hours between 10AM and 10PM'; is_commercially_managed false) + RIDB catalog (reservable flag) + the Forest Service page ('$20 per night first come first served'), read 2026-10-22

note: USFS Nantahala NF (Cheoah RD) on a peninsula of Lake Santeetlah. Only the six electric sites take RVs; the first-come sites are tent sites. Boat ramp and Cheoah Point Beach (no dogs on the beach). --Claude
summary: Changed fees 20/25 -> 25/25 (the $20 first-come sites are tent-only, 22-ft vehicles; RV sites $25). Confirmed 50-amp electric with no water/sewer, 23 sites, showers/flush toilets; added max 40 ft (back-in only), drinking water, no dump station, season Apr 15-Oct 31, 14-night max, operator Forest Service (Cheoah RD). No closure alert (only the Nantahala alcohol restriction). Note trimmed.
